requestedBy: NEW1, bus 0706 — a selector whose per-class precision is unmeasured

design.stratification: court x year-band, band from the PARTITION year in source_url
design.allocation: proportional to stratum size, raised to a floor of 300 where available
design.sampling: TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (1.5) REPEATABLE (20260818), then seeded Fisher-Yates within stratum
design.excluded: court = 'Supreme Court of India' (hc_document_class is a High Court field) and rows whose source_url carries no year= partition

HOW_TO_USE: THIS SAMPLE IS NOT SELF-WEIGHTING. The floor deliberately over-samples small strata.
A corpus-wide class share computed by counting rows in this frame WILL BE WRONG.
Multiply each stratum class count by its `weight` (or divide by `inclusionProbability`) before summing.
Per-stratum figures — including per-class precision within a stratum — need no weighting.
